title: Reconcile the cover stock for Palisade batch 412
handoff: The next press operator needs the cover stock for this batch. Recover both accounts, identify the mismatch and its sources, and leave the choice of stock unresolved until the discrepancy is checked.
key_meaning: For one named environment, press and batch, the single job cover has exactly one cover stock. Both reports concern the same current production batch. Neither author withdrew an account.

Use returned revisions throughout.

replay.predicate: Pass each proposed_assertions array as command.assertions with current expected_revision. Compare silence, omitted, stale, verified and the entire advice list projected to entry_id, trigger, conflicts. resolution: The evidence supports two conflicting current attributions. Neither the store nor this case selects a winner.
